data.description: This spell functions like dispel evil, except that you are surrounded by flickering, yellow chaotic energy, and the spell affects lawful creatures and spells rather than evil ones.

raw_tokens.value: Flickering, yellow chaotic energy surrounds you granting a +4 deflection bonus to AC against attacks by lawful creatures and you can choose to drive lawful creatures back to their home plane on making a successful melee touch attack.|!PRERULE:1,DisplayFullSpell
